name: Campfire
note: Campfire: Make the pine trees and the log cabin slightly paler, softer and hazier, a light blue-green, with simpler shapes and no dark outlines, so they read as far behind the fire. Put warm orange firelight on the stone faces turned toward the flames and a soft glowing pool of light on the dirt around the ring. Make the dirt further from the fire a slightly cooler grey-brown with smooth, plain ground in place of the scattered pebbles. Keep the fire, the logs, the stone ring, the kettle, the grass tufts and the view.
